sentences.cn_text: 西班牙国王胡安·卡洛斯曾坚称：「国王不会退位,他们会在睡梦中离世。」
sentences.en_text: King Juan Carlos of Spain once insisted “kings don’t abdicate, they die in their sleep”.

sentences.cn_text: 但令人尴尬的丑闻以及共和左派在最近欧洲选举中的声势,迫使他收回前言并宣布退位。
sentences.en_text: But embarrassing scandals and the popularity of the republican left in the recent Euroelections have forced him to eat his words and stand down.

sentences.cn_text: 那么,西班牙危机是否意味着君主制正在走向末日?
sentences.en_text: So, does the Spanish crisis suggest that monarchy is seeing its last days?

sentences.cn_text: 这是否预示着所有欧洲王室连同其华丽制服和尊贵生活方式都将走向衰亡?
sentences.en_text: Does that mean the writing is on the wall for all European royals, with their magnificent uniforms and majestic lifestyles?

sentences.cn_text: 西班牙案例为支持和反对君主制提供了双重论据。
sentences.en_text: The Spanish case provides arguments both for and against monarchy.

sentences.cn_text: 当民意严重对立时,如弗朗哥政权终结后的情形,君主能够超越「纯粹」的政治并「体现」民族团结精神。
sentences.en_text: When public opinion is particularly polarised, as it was following the end of the Franco regime, monarchs can rise above “mere” politics and “embody” a spirit of national unity.

sentences.cn_text: 正是这种超越政治的表象,解释了君主作为国家元首持续受欢迎的原因。
sentences.en_text: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs’ continuing popularity as heads of state.

sentences.cn_text: 因此,中东除外,欧洲是世界上君主制最密集的地区,拥有10个王国（不包括梵蒂冈城和安道尔）。
sentences.en_text: And so, the Middle East excepted, Europe is the most monarchinfested region in the world, with 10 kingdoms (not counting Vatican City and Andorra).

sentences.cn_text: 但与海湾和亚洲的专制君主不同,多数王室家族之所以存续至今,是因为他们使选民无需费力寻找既无争议又受人尊敬的公众人物。
sentences.en_text: But unlike their absolutist counterparts in the Gulf and Asia, most royal families have survived because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure.

sentences.cn_text: 即便如此,国王和王后无疑也存在弊端。
sentences.en_text: Even so, kings and queens undoubtedly have a downside.

sentences.cn_text: 尽管他们声称象征民族团结,但其历史本身——有时还包括他们今日的行为方式——却体现着过时且站不住脚的特权和不平等。
sentences.en_text: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history — and sometimes the way they behave today — embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities.

sentences.cn_text: 当托马斯·皮凯蒂等经济学家警告不平等加剧和继承财富力量增强之际,富有的贵族家庭仍是现代民主国家的象征核心,这一现象令人费解。
sentences.en_text: At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.

sentences.cn_text: 最成功的君主制致力于摒弃或隐藏其旧贵族作风。
sentences.en_text: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.

sentences.cn_text: 王子和公主有日常工作并骑自行车出行,而非骑马（或乘坐直升机）。
sentences.en_text: Princes and princesses have day-jobs and ride bicycles, not horses (or helicopters).

sentences.cn_text: 即便如此,这些富裕家族仍与国际顶层1%阶层交往,而媒体的侵扰使其维持恰当形象愈发困难。
sentences.en_text: Even so, these are wealthy families who party with the international 1%, and media intrusiveness makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the right image.

sentences.cn_text: 尽管欧洲君主制无疑足够明智可在未来一段时间继续存续,但英国王室最应从西班牙案例中吸取教训。
sentences.en_text: While Europe’s monarchies will no doubt be smart enough to survive for some time to come, it is the British royals who have most to fear from the Spanish example.

sentences.cn_text: 唯有女王凭借其相当平实（尽管富有）的祖母风范维护了君主制的声誉。
sentences.en_text: It is only the Queen who has preserved the monarchy’s reputation with her rather ordinary (if well-heeled) granny style.

sentences.cn_text: 危机将来自查尔斯,他既有奢华的生活品味,又持有相当等级森严的世界观。
sentences.en_text: The danger will come with Charles, who has both an expensive taste of lifestyle and a pretty hierarchical view of the world.

sentences.cn_text: 他未能理解君主制之所以在很大程度上存续至今,是因为它们提供了一种服务——作为无争议且非政治化的国家元首。
sentences.en_text: He has failed to understand that monarchies have largely survived because they provide a service — as noncontroversial and non-political heads of state.

sentences.cn_text: 查尔斯应当明白,正如英国历史所示,君主制最大的敌人是国王自身,而非共和派。
sentences.en_text: Charles ought to know that as English history shows, it is kings, not republicans, who are the monarchy’s worst enemies.

sentences.en_text: According to the first two paragraphs, King Juan Carlos of Spain ____

sentences.en_text: used to enjoy high public support.

sentences.en_text: eased his relationship with his rivals.

sentences.cn_text: 在尴尬中结束了统治。
sentences.en_text: ended his reign in embarrassment.

sentences.en_text: Monarchs are kept as heads of state in Europe mostly ____

sentences.cn_text: 君主拥有无可争议且受人尊敬的地位。
sentences.en_text: owing to their undoubted and respectable status.

sentences.cn_text: 要在传统与现实之间取得平衡。
sentences.en_text: to achieve a balance between tradition and reality.

sentences.cn_text: 要为选民提供更多值得景仰的公众人物。
sentences.en_text: to give voters more public figures to look up to.

sentences.cn_text: 君主具有恒久的政治象征意义。
sentences.en_text: due to their everlasting political embodiment.

sentences.cn_text: 根据第4段,下列哪一项被认为是反常的?
sentences.en_text: Which of the following is shown to be odd, according to Paragraph 4?

sentences.cn_text: 贵族对继承财富的过度依赖。
sentences.en_text: Aristocrats’ excessive reliance on inherited wealth.

sentences.cn_text: 贵族在现代民主制度中的角色。
sentences.en_text: The role of the nobility in modern democracies.

sentences.cn_text: 贵族家庭的简朴生活方式。
sentences.en_text: The simple lifestyle of the aristocratic families.

sentences.cn_text: 贵族对自身特权的固守。
sentences.en_text: The nobility’s adherence to their privileges.

sentences.cn_text: 英国王室「最值得担忧」是因为查尔斯 ____
sentences.en_text: The British royals “have most to fear” because Charles ____

sentences.cn_text: 在政治问题上立场强硬。
sentences.en_text: takes a tough line on political issues.

sentences.cn_text: 未能按建议改变生活方式。
sentences.en_text: fails to change his lifestyle as advised.

sentences.cn_text: 将共和派视为潜在盟友。
sentences.en_text: takes republicans as his potential allies.

sentences.cn_text: 未能使自己适应未来角色。
sentences.en_text: fails to adapt himself to his future role.

sentences.cn_text: 下列哪项是本文的最佳标题?
sentences.en_text: Which of the following is the best title of the text?

sentences.cn_text: 卡洛斯：荣辱参半。
sentences.en_text: Carlos, Glory and Disgrace Combined.

sentences.cn_text: 查尔斯：急于继承王位。
sentences.en_text: Charles, Anxious to Succeed to the Throne.

sentences.cn_text: 卡洛斯：给所有欧洲君主的前车之鉴。
sentences.en_text: Carlos, a Lesson for All European Monarchs.

sentences.cn_text: 查尔斯：对即将到来的威胁反应迟钝。
sentences.en_text: Charles, Slow to React to the Coming Threats.
